entries.appliesTo: University System of Maryland (AI Partnership, Fellowship, Incubation Lab), Morgan State University's Center for Equitable AI, and the Department of Information Technology

params.program: AI Partnership + hubs + fellowship + incubation lab + scholarship expansion

sources.program: § 12-124(B)(1) — 'THERE IS A MARYLAND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE PARTNERSHIP IN THE UNIVERSITY SYSTEM OF MARYLAND'; § 12-125(B) — 'THERE IS AN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE PUBLIC SERVICE FELLOWSHIP IN THE UNIVERSITY SYSTEM OF MARYLAND'; § 12-126(B)(1) — 'SUBJECT TO A MEMORAND UM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE UNIVERSITY SYSTEM OF MARYLAND AND THE DEPARTMENT OF BUDGET AND MANAGEMENT, THERE IS AN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE INCUBATION LAB'

flags: No company compliance duties, no penalty or enforcement provisions — programs-only act binding state universities and agencies (exposure omitted; silence is silence).

Strategic plan mandate: § 12-124(C)(1)(I) — 'ON OR BEFORE DECEMBER 1, 2026, THE PARTNERSHIP SHALL DEVELOP A STRATEGIC PLAN', with annual progress reports per § 12-124(C)(2) — 'ON OR BEFORE DECEMBER 1, 2027, AND EACH DECEMBER 1 THEREAFTER, THE PARTNERSHIP SHALL SUBMIT A PROGRESS REPORT'; no fixed-vocabulary duty/param fits a strategic-plan obligation on a state partnership.

Maryland Technology Extension Hubs pilot: § 12-124(D)(2) — 'ON OR BEFORE DECEMBER 15, 2026 2027, THERE SHALL BE ONE HUB IN EACH OF THREE REGIONS OF THE STATE ESTABLISHED ON A PILOT BASIS'; hubs must 'PROVIDE ARTIFICIAL IN TELLIGENCE SKILLS TR AINING TO INDIVIDUALS AT NO CH ARGE'.

Morgan State research role: § 14-111(B)(3) requires the Center for Equitable AI and Machine Learning Systems to submit research reports to the Governor's AI Subcabinet and the Joint Committee on Cybersecurity, Information Technology, and Biotechnology.

Scholarship provisions (§§ 18-3501 to 18-3504) rename the Cybersecurity Public Service Scholarship Program to the 'EMERGING TECHNOLOGY Public Service Scholarship Program' and extend eligibility to 'cybersecurity OR ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE' — student-facing higher-ed funding, not a school-district mandate, so kept in this public-sector entry rather than education-k12.
Category judgment: bill is housed in higher education but binds the University System, DoIT, and state agencies rather than K-12 schools/districts/curricula, so 'public-sector' over 'education'.
Chaptered text shows strike/insert artifacts (e.g. 'DECEMBER 15, 2026 2027' and renumbered clauses '(IV) (III)'); quotes preserve the printed enrolled text including OCR spacing.
